method: World v2 (lane-s5). Categorical soft-label index master at 16x (4096): one-hot mask of every native index blurred at 4x and texel-centred bilinear to 16x; crisp contours (sigma 0.42 texel, power 4); tone-group blending of dithers between indices that share the class under every renderable static CLUT and are within RGB 56 under >= 75 % of them (sigma 1.0 texel, dither window 0.3..0.65); top-3 labels; lost-texel rounded-square cores; native index forced at every texel centre. FX contract boxes on 1A2ACF78 (smoke puffs, dark puff sprites, smoke trails): any-pair tone blending (render keeps only the dominant label's class per CLUT), crisp 0.42/4, blend 1.0 texel, dither window 0.15..0.4, no cores, centres not forced in the master (exports stamp the native class), no material. Material logD at 8x (palette-independent): relief 0.18 from the review-CLUT luminance (sigma 0.9 texel, light from the upper left), groove AO 0.1 at luminance edges, luminance detail from the lane-s5 stage-5 JuggernautXL swatches sandblasted_concrete (s5-swatches-v1) and sandworn_steel_a (s5-swatches-v2) per page (raw images, centre 60 %, random Hann-windowed patches, high-pass 48 px, band-limited 1.5 px at 2048), procedural low-frequency grime 0.03; zero-mean per native index over the material area. 05E1881C is not built (lane-s4 owns it).
render_formula: w = top-3 soft labels; base = sum_k w_k P[l_k] over labels of the dominant class; rgb = base * exp(logD) (opaque classes); class = class(P[l_0]); runtime = majority-class box-down of the 4096 render + native class stamped at floor((i+0.5)*scale)

class_validation.convention: class at pixel floor((i+0.5)*scale) of every native texel == class(CLUT[native index]); class 0 = raw 0x0000, 255 = STP, 127 = opaque

alpha_channel: categorical PSX classes (0 = raw 0x0000, 127 opaque, 255 STP), NOT opacity; exact at every native texel centre

regions.near: any index pair (render keeps only labels of the dominant class per CLUT)
regions.centres: not forced in the master (no 1-px native dots in the fades); every export stamps the native class at every texel centre

honest_read: Material: the flat plates and walls now carry pitted, sand-blasted concrete and fine vertical satin-steel grain (stage-5 swatches) instead of v1's Stage 1 vertical streaks/grime. It is subtle (luminance only, amp 0.045) and reads as a weathered sandblasted surface at 16x; at in-game size it is barely visible. Motion SIMULATION shows no penalty: the material-control regions twinkle the same as v1 (3 px per texel: 9F3D98EF 0.0305 -> 0.0300, 7E088757 0.0478 -> 0.0477, 452F3CC3 0.0430 -> 0.0429, 503474BD 0.0472 -> 0.0469; native nearest 0.16-0.26).

1A2ACF78 smoke (FX contract boxes): the posterised tone plateaus of v1 become soft continuous gradients. The price is softness: at 16x the puffs and trails look blurred, and the dark puff sprites on the teal ground lose their crisp dark rim (local contrast -13 %). Twinkle barely changes because v1 was already dither-blended: puffs 0.0173 -> 0.0159, dark puffs 0.0301 -> 0.0230, and the smoke trails get slightly worse, 0.0155 -> 0.0170 (native 0.068-0.166). At 9 px per texel every region is <= 0.008.

Unchanged from v1: dither and noise become rounded blotches; long tone staircases stay as rounded steps; 1-texel frames of alternating tones (452F3CC3 window frame, 503474BD rail) are bead chains at 16x; single-texel spikes become rounded nubs. This is a faithful, soft base, far from the Stage 1 canyon/facade realism.
No 8bpp sub-images on the world pages (alt8_mask finds 0 blocks on all five).
Review CLUTs are the same unproven pairings as v1 (51E8E21E, 793A3662, 6A8B1A18, 1A80CA9D).
known_limits: All keys are predicted-static: import only after the stage-5 run confirms each key (validate_predicted.py confirm + gate).
One render per page; 102 further static predicted keys render from the same masters later; palette-hold keys wait for AQ-05.

FX boxes: the master's texel-centre labels are not forced there (no 1-px native dots in the fades); every export stamps the native class at every texel centre (0 mismatches). Re-render only through w7lib.export_rgba.
Material relief comes from the review CLUT's luminance and can invert locally under another CLUT (zero-mean per index keeps average colours).
